title: Nonexoneration.
bodyText: A specific devise passes subject to any mortgage interest existing at the date of death, without right of exoneration, regardless of a general directive in the will to pay debts.
bodyHtml: §560:2-607  Nonexoneration.  A specific devise passes subject to any mortgage interest existing at the date of death, without right of exoneration, regardless of a general directive in the will to pay debts. [L 1996, c 288, pt of §1]
